name: school_attendance
summary: Roll-call attendance sessions with per-learner records, append-only post-finalization corrections, live session summaries and an automated absence-alert scan
description: Implements the attendance module from the blueprint. A school.attendance.session is a roll-call for a class/section on a date, optionally tied to a timetable lesson, and moves through a server-validated draft, open, finalized and cancelled lifecycle. Each learner is marked on a school.attendance.line as present, absent, late or excused; a populate action seeds one line per active learner in the section and finalize is blocked while no marks exist. Once a session is finalized, amending a mark is not a silent edit: the correction action requires a reason, flags the record corrected and journals an immutable school.attendance.correction row capturing the actor and the from/to status. Live per-session summaries (present, absent, late, excused counts and the attendance rate) are exposed as non-stored computes. A nightly cron aggregates unexcused absences within a rolling window and raises deduplicated school.absence.alert records for learners crossing the threshold, which can be acknowledged and resolved. Navigated under the single School app.
author: Nexa
